title: nan
authors: Imran A.; Varadharajan V.S.; Gomes Braga R.; Beltrame G.; St-Onge D.
key_contribution: Presents a comparative study and experimental evaluation of swarm robot relative localization systems (IR, VIO, UWB, spatial foundation models) in GNSS-denied settings.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
